$comment: Index of the ClavaMetrics support center. Defines the WORLDS (their order, labels and icons). The list of pages inside each world is derived automatically by scripts/build-docs.mjs from the frontmatter of docs-site/content/<lang>/*.md (grouped by `world`, ordered by `order`). Add a new page = add a new .md file with the right frontmatter; no need to edit this file unless you are adding/renaming a world.
